budget_items.what_was_said: The town manager/staff explained that Green Communities is a state program that funds certain efficiency projects for cities and towns, such as mini-splits and building weatherization, provided the project meets ROI/efficiency standards. It was noted the program previously funded HVAC/mini-split work at the primary school.

decisions.decision: Richard Taylor decided to withdraw his interest in the other committees he had listed and focus solely on the Americans with Disabilities Committee.

The board agreed not to appoint Vincent ("Vinnie") to Green Communities tonight; he will submit an application/form and be connected with the committee chair (David Blatt) before a future appointment.
The board agreed to keep Dave Passios as the full Green Communities member and expects an additional full-member vacancy when Dave Blatt leaves the community in the fall.
The board noted the Americans with Disabilities Committee likely cannot meet again until it has a member-at-large and a select board representative assigned, which may not happen until August.

minutes.summary: This Select Board meeting was devoted entirely to annual appointments and reappointments to town boards, committees and commissions, with the board interviewing each applicant briefly before voting. By the end of the meeting the board had filled seats on the APDC, Council on Aging, Americans with Disabilities Committee, Conservation Committee, Cultural Council, Green Communities and a newly reconstituted five-member Personnel Committee, leaving remaining vacancies only on Conservation, Cultural Council, Historical Commission and PAC.

Overview of the appointments process for the evening
Conservation Committee reappointment and remaining vacancy
Green Communities Committee appointment and discussion of upcoming vacancy

Reappoint Elena Christopher and appoint Christopher Johnson to the Council on Aging (terms to expire June 30, 2029)
Appoint Pauline Roy to the Council on Aging for a term to expire June 30, 2029
Ratify the town manager's appointment of Richard Taylor and Heather Gleason to the Americans with Disabilities Committee
Reappoint Richard Bursch to the Conservation Committee for a three-year term
Appoint Carla Velasquez to the Cultural Council for a term of 3 years
Appoint Dave Passios as a full member of Green Communities, term to expire June 30, 2029
Appoint David Bartlett (1-year), Pauline Roy (2-year), and Tanya Doll (3-year) to the newly reconstituted Personnel Committee

minutes.headline: The Select Board reconstituted the Personnel Committee as a five-member body and filled its seats along with most other town board vacancies.

what_happened.line: The Select Board reconstituted the Personnel Committee as a five-member body and appointed three members to it.
The board also filled seats on the APDC, Council on Aging, Americans with Disabilities Committee, Conservation Committee, Cultural Council and Green Communities.
The Americans with Disabilities Committee is not expected to meet again until it has a member-at-large and a Select Board representative assigned, possibly not until August.
Vacancies remain on the Conservation Committee, Cultural Council, Historical Commission and PAC.

why_it_matters: Residents interested in serving on a town board now know which seats are filled and which -- Conservation, Cultural Council, Historical Commission, PAC -- are still open.
The Personnel Committee's reconstitution affects how the town handles personnel policy matters going forward.
A delay in staffing the Americans with Disabilities Committee could postpone its work on accessibility issues into the fall.
watch_next: Assignment of a member-at-large and a Select Board representative to the Americans with Disabilities Committee, expected around August 2026
Applications for the remaining Conservation Committee, Cultural Council, Historical Commission and PAC vacancies

reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on all eight appointment votes and their outcomes (3-0 or unanimous, all passed). The differences are name spellings from the captions, plus a few discussion points that only one record carries.
